# Northern New Jersey vendor candidates

This file is research for owner review. It is not a live vendor list.

Import it at `/admin/vendors/import` after the A5-008 migration is applied. Every accepted row is stored as `DISCOVERED` and is not accepting leads. Approve a row, then set it to `ACTIVE` and accepting leads, before it can be assigned.

Towns and services are only those named on the public page cited in `source_url`. Businesses that did not name an approved A5 town were left out.

Do not treat this file as proof of license, insurance, or quality.
